pos.personaBrief: Bielsa wants his teams to 'protagonizar, atacar, jugar en campo rival' (2023) and to be 'prepared to have possession of the ball and to win it back' (2012); Athletic averaged 57% possession and Leeds held opponents to 38.5%, but the play is vertical rather than for its own sake.

pro.personaBrief: Play avoids 'las demoras innecesarias y la lateralización' (2002) with verticality (Chilavert) and transitions 'a pura velocidad' (Uruguay 2024), yet Leeds had 'a strong desire to play out from the back' with a pivot dropping between centre-backs, even against City's press.

est.personaBrief: Newell's had 'todo diagramado, todos los movimientos entrenados'; the 3-3-1-3 / 4-1-4-1 uses high wingers and full-backs to stretch the pitch, with rehearsed rotations and third-man runs rather than tight improvised combinations.

lar.personaBrief: Bielsa says 'la mayoría de los goles nacen de los costados' (2003); Argentina's wide midfielders had 'funciones netas de ataque', Chile used 'the extremes', Leeds built 2v1s on the flanks and Uruguay's full-backs stood 'como punteros'.

blo.personaBrief: Pressing is the hallmark across spells: Newell's recovered 'lo más cerca del arco rival', Argentina pushed all lines up, Ferguson saw Athletic 'press the ball everywhere', Marseille had Ligue 1's lowest PPDA, Leeds' press led by the striker, Uruguay's 'presión asfixiante'.

mar.personaBrief: Verified evidence from Athletic ('militaristic man-marking'), Marseille ('4231 à marquages individuels'), Leeds ('Each outfielder aggressively tracks their opponent', one spare centre-back) and Uruguay ('marcar hombre a hombre') shows man-oriented defending.

pla.personaBrief: Bielsa states 'No hay planes alternativos en la forma de jugar' (2024) and his teams play the same 'de visitante o local' (Chilavert); he studies every opponent obsessively (Spygate), but uses it to sharpen his own model, not to abandon it.

res.personaBrief: He believes 'playing well will get you closer to achieving the right result' and accepts the risk of it (2024), wanted to go to the Bernabéu and win, and says 'si por algo hay que descompensar un equipo, debe ser por atacar'.

sis.personaBrief: A drilled collective where 'the 10 outfield players attack and the 11 defend', wingers must defend even if they dislike it and Bielsa corrects 'sin importar quién seas'; he values the player with a 'porcentaje alto' over flashy virtues.

jog.personaBrief: The style 'demands particularly impressive conditioning' and record running distances, yet Bielsa says physical effort and creativity are 'compatible values', using passing pivots like Phillips and Ugarte as the first passer.

bas.personaBrief: With Argentina he 'apostó por jóvenes futbolistas' from his youth sides and led Athletic's young core, but at Leeds his loyalty to a small group of regulars limited academy chances (Goal 2021).

lid.personaBrief: Players describe a demanding, persistent coach who 'te dice la verdad' to anyone and controls every detail, even training strikers separately; the authority rests on work and honesty rather than on dressing-room harmony.
